description: Two views of the same small chibi pixel art head, bald, with long pointed ears: on the left seen from the front, on the right seen from behind. Paint only inside the white of the mask: put the same hat on both heads, sitting straight and a little loose, its band resting just above the ears and a little wider than the head: a pale straw sun hat with a round crown and a very wide floppy brim drawn as a thick solid band at least three pixels deep all round, not a thin line, with a sky-blue ribbon tied in a bow (seen from behind, the back of the pale straw sun hat, its wide thick brim all round and the sky-blue ribbon's tails). Simple bold shapes. Keep the same chunky pixel size, the same thick dark outline and the same flat shading with a few tones per colour. The head, the face and the ears stay exactly as they are, nothing else added, transparent background.
